_meta.name: gov-os base view tree
_meta.status: v1, 2026-07-15, owner-ruled in session; structured form of design/25-VIEW-TREE.md
rulings: two definitive stores only: event store, item store; relationship is derived
numbering = derivation: each child is its parent plus exactly one move (filter, product, split)
parentage is not exclusive; the tree shows primary deriving logic
active-only from depth: [a] views hold current state; history/asOf = once-off queries, never nodes
functional necessity only: everything else is a custom view created through the view req view
dos = must-happen (condition -> system makes it happen); donts = must-not-happen (condition -> system prevents)
may is NOT a rule class: it is the residual computed per call; permission/sight/authority/due/wake/consistency are LIVE CHECKS, never stored views
default-deny = the root donts (no authorising chain -> no act); grants create the chain that un-matches the root dont

stores.name: event store
stores.note: definitive; every assertion, prescriptive or not; append-only

stores.name: item store
stores.note: definitive; versioned nouns; address = item_id x record_time; content bytes by hash

views.name: req view
views.via: filter: prescriptive events, all lifecycle states
views.note: drafts, active, retired, remembered; lifecycle slices are once-off

views.name: active req view
views.via: filter: put in power, not retired
views.note: the law in force now

views.name: active dos view
views.note: must-happen; condition -> system makes it happen; timers, handlers, udev-style bindings, routing all live here

views.name: compliance view
views.note: who is bound by what, now

views.name: local duty profile
views.note: one actor's standing obligations; per-actor prefilter surface

views.name: active donts view
views.note: must-not-happen; includes root donts (default-deny); firewall, seccomp-style filters, locks, protection bits, rlimits all live here

views.name: view req view
views.via: filter: reqs whose object is a view
views.note: the meta-view: dictates creation, refresh, broadcast of every custom view

views.name: activity log view
views.note: the happenings; the log itself is the store; slices are once-off

views.name: governance activity log view
views.note: decisions, grants, refusals, amendments; the audit spine

views.name: wait/wake view
views.via: fold: block events minus wake events
views.note: who is blocked on which condition; live check wake() matches arrivals against it

views.name: action view
views.via: filter: verb items registered, not retired
views.note: the registry IS this view; unregistered = does not exist

views.name: resource view
views.note: actor-inclusive

views.name: actor view
views.note: class = S/U position, nothing else

views.name: system actors
views.note: deterministic, same for all; tags: subsystem, device, process

views.name: human actors
views.note: owner, admins, users

views.name: agentic actors
views.note: tiered: org as a whole, each bot; pwc lives here

views.name: system information view
views.note: the info-architecture layer

views.name: information space view
views.note: what permissions attach to; spaces nest

views.name: permanent space
views.note: disk-backed

views.name: non-permanent space
views.note: ram, transient; persistence is the ONLY intrinsic space dimension

views.name: information scope item view
views.note: content never sits bare in a space

views.name: view list view
views.note: a view is itself a scope item

views.name: content-housing item
views.note: file and memory region unified; which it is derives from its space's persistence

views.name: system policy/rule item
views.note: req events attach by reference; e.g. usb-port-blocking policy

views.name: information content item view
views.note: hash addressing is store mechanism; as-of-T is a once-off query

views.name: tunnel item view
views.note: endpoints are relations; payloads are content items

views.name: relationship view
views.via: projection: slot pairs from events, frame-scoped
views.note: derived master graph; regenerable; never asserted, never stored transitively

views.name: parent-child view
views.note: chained, walkable; frames give space tree, paths, custody, policy composition, authority lineage

views.name: contact view
views.note: frames give shared regions, channel topology, conflict surfaces; distance-beyond-one is once-off

live_checks.name: permission(actor, action, object, target)
live_checks.note: the may-space computed per call; a do matching = compelled; a dont matching (incl. root donts, unless an authorising chain exists) = blocked; else free

live_checks.name: sight(actor, item)
live_checks.note: permission specialised to reading; feeds provenance; sight binds action

live_checks.name: authority(actor, amendment)
live_checks.note: walk grant events to founding grounds, live, at amendment time

live_checks.name: due(now-state)
live_checks.note: which dos' conditions are hit; the only reason anything ever fires

live_checks.name: wake(arrival)
live_checks.note: match one arrival against the blocked set

live_checks.name: consistency(proposed-req)
live_checks.note: same frame, same scope, at CREATE-RULE time

tiers.1_base: the tree above; permanent, workered, [a] = active content
tiers.2_working: hot products composed from base, cached ephemerally, no governance machinery on the hot path: runnable set, memory map, path resolution, bindings, channel topology, headroom
tiers.3_custom: everything else (audit dashboards, metabolism, history cuts, domain slices); created only through the view req view; permanent only if a req says so
